sourceNotes: 修复 macOS 15 上蓝牙设备列表触发的启动崩溃

en: Fix a startup crash triggered by Bluetooth device lists on macOS 15 and harden list rendering in monitoring pages, menu bar details, and the update page. If the old version cannot launch, download the 1.3.2 DMG, drag XStats into Applications to replace it, and reopen the app
